MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot felt relevant because voice control could complement my Fire TV setup, provided the devices work together as expected.",
    "The HDMI cable felt useful as a possible connection accessory for my television setup, though I would verify which devices need it and whether the length fits."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The older and HD-only Fire TV sticks repeat a function my existing 4K stick already handles, without a clear improvement for my 4K television.",
    "The tablets and earbuds address portable viewing or listening needs I have not shown; my recent purchases concern home television and cameras.",
    "The extender, memory card, and smart plug depend on needs I have not established: poor Wi-Fi coverage, compatible storage requirements, or an appliance I want to automate."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any Amazon or Alexa device, even when it serves a different purpose.",
    "Owning cameras and television equipment seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest broadly related accessories without checking whether they solve a current problem."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I already own a 4K streaming stick and a 4K television, so another streamer needs a specific benefit beyond repeating what I have.",
    "A useful next purchase should add a capability or complete a connection in my existing setup, with compatibility established.",
    "I choose equipment for specific purposes; a possible future use is not enough for me to buy an accessory now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in home electronics but too often confused related devices with useful additions to what I already own."
}
